limits: closed-loop client and application share host; no production SLA
JVM ps %cpu is process lifetime average; Docker CPU is interval sample
no per-request DB lock wait or queue metric; no Redis outage claim

contract.statistics: nearest-rank percentiles across all responses; throughput includes drain, warmup excluded; latency and throughput observational, no SLA
contract.isolation: one fresh environment; new fixture per round; distributed has one venue and space per worker, hotspot shares one; previous S02 stacks stopped; other user processes are not stopped
contract.rateLimitBoundary: explicit isolated override from default90 to1000000 per path/IP/minute to expose transaction costs; does not represent default public endpoint throughput
